nodes.meshy.sourcePreviewEmpty: No preview available from current source
nodes.meshy.meshyPreviewSub: Used to confirm if the current task result has been updated
nodes.meshy.creditCost: Unit price {price} credits/image, estimated cost {cost} credits
nodes.meshy.imageConfigNote: Note: Per Meshy docs, aspect ratio cannot be set when multi-view is enabled; image-to-image supports up to 5 reference images.
nodes.meshy.meshModeNote: Current: {mode}. In lowpoly mode, ai_model / topology / target_polycount / should_remesh / save_pre_remeshed_model are ignored.
nodes.meshy.targetPolycountNote: Range: 100 - 300000, only effective during remesh stage.
nodes.meshy.symmetryModeNote: Auto determines symmetry based on input geometry.
nodes.meshy.shouldRemeshNote: When off, returns high-precision triangle mesh directly; topology and target_polycount are ignored.
nodes.meshy.savePreRemeshedNote: Corresponds to save_pre_remeshed_model, only effective when should_remesh=true.
nodes.meshy.shouldTextureNote: When off, only mesh is generated; enable_pbr and texture guide params will be disabled.
nodes.meshy.enablePbrNote: Outputs base_color + metallic + roughness + normal when enabled.
nodes.meshy.texturePromptNote: When provided with texture_image_url, texture_prompt takes priority.
nodes.meshy.textureImageUrlPlaceholder: Optional. Supports URL or Data URI.
nodes.meshy.textureImageUrlNote: Used to guide material style; choose one of texture_prompt or this for clarity.
nodes.meshy.autoSizeNote: When enabled, server estimates real height automatically.
nodes.meshy.originAtNote: Only effective when auto_size=true; default is bottom per docs.
nodes.meshy.imageEnhancementNote: Only supported when ai_model is meshy-6 / latest.
nodes.meshy.removeLightingNote: Makes base color cleaner for re-lighting in engine.
nodes.meshy.targetFormatsNote: When omitted, server returns all supported formats. Recommended to keep glb at minimum.
nodes.meshy.seedNote: For reproducibility; same input and seed produce more stable results.
nodes.meshy.promptPlaceholder: Enter directly, or connect from a text node. Connected text input takes priority.
nodes.meshy.negativePromptPlaceholder: e.g., low quality, low poly, ugly
nodes.meshy.refImageUrlPlaceholder: Enter directly, or override via reference image anchor input.
nodes.meshy.multiImagePlaceholderI2I: One URL per line, max 5; connected image input anchors take priority.
nodes.meshy.multiImagePlaceholderM2I: One URL per line, max 4; connected image input anchors take priority.
nodes.meshy.collapsedNote: Performance collapsed view. Select this node to show the full parameter form.
nodes.meshy.targetSubtitleImage: Node handles image pipeline task orchestration, input summary, and output distribution.
nodes.meshy.targetSubtitle3dTexture: This node has switched to the texture stage; downstream 3D nodes will prefer texture output.
nodes.meshy.targetSubtitle3d: Node handles 3D pipeline task orchestration, input summary, and output distribution.
nodes.meshy.outputSummaryImage: out-image-1 ~ out-image-{count} connect to downstream image inputs
nodes.meshy.outputSummary3d: out-model must connect to downstream resource/model inputs
nodes.meshy.statusDetailImage: Image pipeline will integrate with task center and help panel in a future update.
nodes.meshy.statusDetail3d: 3D results are output via out-model to downstream nodes.
nodes.meshy.remeshUnsupported: Remesh standalone task API not yet integrated; this batch completes the base model + texture loop.
nodes.meshy.errorNoPrompt: Please fill in a prompt or connect text input
nodes.meshy.errorMultiViewRatio: Fixed aspect ratio cannot be set when multi-view is enabled.
nodes.meshy.errorI2INoImage: Image to Image requires at least 1 reference image URL or input anchor.
nodes.meshy.errorRefineNoId: Refine stage requires a Preview Task ID
nodes.meshy.errorI2dNoImage: Please fill in image URL or connect reference image
nodes.meshy.errorM2INoImage: Please provide at least one reference image
nodes.meshy.textureHintNotBase: This node is no longer in the base model stage.
nodes.meshy.textureHintNotSucceeded: Generate the base model first before continuing with texturing.
nodes.meshy.textureHintReady: Launch a texture subtask based on the current model task.
nodes.meshy.actionHintFailed: Task failed, please adjust parameters and try again.
nodes.meshy.actionHintTexture: This node has entered the texture stage; downstream model nodes will prefer texture results.
nodes.meshy.actionHintImage: Before running, verifies that out-image is connected to downstream image inputs.
nodes.meshy.actionHint3d: Before running, verifies that out-model is connected to downstream model/resource inputs.
